calls.title: saved groups approval
calls.summary: The team focused on finalizing the naming as 'Block co authors from approving drafts' to clarify contributor roles and maintain UI consistency. They aligned terminology across features, emphasizing a coherent user experience with approval flows. The system now mandates that all edits pass through a draft revision, ensuring robust version control. UI updates were made, notably in standardizing table components and enhancing layout consistency. The possibility of adding revision audit logs was discussed based on user demand, along with prioritizing bug fixes affecting revision creation and publishing. The team acknowledged the importance of communication and coordination as they prepare for a release of the updated features.
calls.keywords: Draft approvals, Save groups, Versioning, User cohorts, Audit logs, Feature flags
calls.action_items:

Implement draft notification feature that allows users to switch directly to existing drafts when multiple users have drafts on the same feature (26:36)

Test and address horizontal scrolling issues on smaller laptop screens to improve usability (40:55)
Prepare final pull request for review and testing to complete the current development cycle (41:35)
